rules: Question IDs must be globally unique across all sources.
Never overwrite existing questions when importing another PDF.
Keep original source page and chapter numbering.
Use sourceId/year metadata for user-facing source filters; users still see one unified question bank.
Flag ambiguous, bonus, unreadable, or unverified answers instead of treating them as verified.
Image crops must contain exactly one complete question, including all options and diagrams.
